title: A detection preview must stay a preview - stop auto-adding SAM3 picks to the live mask
description: Found during MPI-365 live verification, 2026-08-02. Running a SAM3 detect currently ADDS its result to the mask without the user pressing Add: MpiCanvasViewer.js `exec.onMasks` calls `canvas.setSelectedAutoPicks(runPicks)` then `el.evaluateMask()`, and MaskManager's composite is `(manual AND NOT subtract) UNION selectedAutoPicks`, so `hasMask()` goes true and `getURL()` ships those pixels straight into `Input_Mask`. The user generated with an un-Added detection and the pick was injected. The green overlay is a PREVIEW of what the detection could do to the mask, and the user's next move may be Subtract, not Add - so consuming it as mask content is wrong in both directions. The current behaviour is deliberate (the MPI-372 / MPI-384 contract: a detection must unlock the op strip, since picking a chip 'puts real pixels in maskCanvas'), so this card REVERSES that decision and must re-gate the op strip on baked content instead - or the strip locks again until Add and MPI-372's bug returns. Verbatim from the user: 'If a preview stops being a preview, it is no longer a preview... It should not automatically add to the current mask. The user might want to subtract it.' Touch points: MpiCanvasViewer.js (onMasks, evaluateMask, getCurrentMaskDataURL), MaskManager.js (_recomposite, getURL, hasMaskContent consumers), and whatever gates the op strip. Belongs to the masking umbrella (MPI-424 / MPI-425 family).
acceptance: maskCanvas is manual AND NOT subtract - selected auto picks are NOT unioned in, so hasMask() and getURL() cannot see an un-Added detection
The twin _buildCompositeFromTemp() drops persisted auto picks the same way - it feeds _previewMaskCache and getCurrentMaskDataURL() in preview mode, which was the second door to the same bug
Display is unchanged: picks stay in autoCanvas and MpiCanvas still draws them green on top (verified pixel-identical - the recolour is opaque)
Op strip gates on BAKED content (user decision 2026-08-04) - a bare detection leaves masked ops locked until Add, and this needed no new code because _opOptions() already reads hasMask()
bakeAutoPicksInto() remains the only door into mask content, and Add-then-Subtract still punches the region out
Pick persistence is untouched - picks still restore across entry switches to rehydrate the preview and thumb strip
Proven by a real-pixel probe against the live MaskManager (12/12) WITH a sabotage control that failed exactly the two bug assertions; 392/392 node suite; eslint clean
The reversal is written to docs/masking.md, docs/masking-tools.md and docs/masking-sam3.md, replacing the stale MPI-372/384 contract text
